Tech Week redirect URLs are taken fresh from the live calendar on each sync (matched identities adopt the scraped event_url; stale /go/event/ tokens are not preserved).
Mobile/desktop repetitions are collapsed; only identical event records are deduplicated.
Neighborhoods are not venue addresses. End times, prices, and descriptions are not supplied by these rows.
MCP search defaults to city=sf unless LA (or all) is requested explicitly.
